fusions.name: Plodding Blow
fusions.desc: A heavy, unhurried blow that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Inevitable
fusions.desc: A crushing blow on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Slow Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Recovery
fusions.desc: When you are hurt, healing you receives is 30% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
